exposure: Outpatient labor induction priming with dinoprostone
outcome: Composite neonatal safety outcome (5-minute Apgar score <7 and NICU admission for >12 hours or transfer to a level III nursery)
cohort: Women undergoing labor inductions for premature rupture of membranes or postdate gestation
finding: Outpatient labor induction using dinoprostone inserts for premature rupture of membranes or postdate gestation is feasible, safe, and associated with similar neonatal outcomes compared to inpatient induction.
mod_finding: The outpatient cohort was less likely to deliver by cesarean section compared to the inpatient cohort.
birth_weight: Outpatient cohort: 3705 g, Inpatient cohort: 3551 g
